name: sccache warmup

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  SCCACHE_GCS_BUCKET: gs://walrus-sccache
  SCCACHE_GCS_BUCKET_REGION: us-west1

jobs:
  warmup:
    name: Warmup sccache (${{ matrix.os }} - ${{ matrix.build_type }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-arm64, windows-latest, macos-latest, macos-arm64]
        build_type: [debug, release]
      fail-fast: false
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Authenticate to GCP
        uses: google-github-actions/auth@v0.5.0
        with:
          credentials_json: ${{ secrets.GCP_WALRUS_RELEASE_BUCKET_SVCUSER_CREDENTIALS }}

      - name: Set up sccache
        uses: mozilla-actions/sccache-action@v0.0.9
        with:
          version: latest
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          disable_annotations: true

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v2
        with:
          rust-version: stable
          cache: false

      - name: Build (${{ matrix.build_type }})
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [ "${{ matrix.build_type }}" = "debug" ]; then
            cargo build --workspace --features "walrus-service/backup"
          else
            cargo build --release
          fi

      - name: Notify failure to sui-operations
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        env:
          SUI_OPERATIONS_PAT: ${{ secrets.SUI_OPERATIONS_PAT }}
        with:
          script: |
            const token = process.env.SUI_OPERATIONS_PAT;
            if (!token) {
              core.setFailed('SUI_OPERATIONS_PAT secret is missing');
              return;
            }
            await github.rest.repos.createDispatchEvent({
              owner: 'SuiLabs',
              repo: 'sui-operations',
              event_type: 'sccache-warmup-failure',
              client_payload: {
                workflow: 'sccache-warmup',
                status: 'failure',
                os: '${{ matrix.os }}',
                build_type: '${{ matrix.build_type }}'
              }
            });
